focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期临近尾声，中国出口企业须加快碳数据合规布局
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入实质征收阶段。钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力及氢能等六大行业对欧出口企业，须在过渡期内完成产品隐含碳排放的核算与申报，并逐步建立经第三方核查的碳数据体系。未合规申报可能导致对欧贸易成本显著上升，甚至面临市场准入障碍。建议企业尽快梳理对欧出口产品清单，对接欧盟认可的核查机构，并评估供应链碳足迹优化空间。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司政策通报 · 2026.09.10
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Accelerate Carbon Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: The EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period will conclude at the end of 2026, with substantive levies commencing in 2027. Exporters to the EU in six sectors—iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity, and hydrogen—must complete embedded emissions accounting and reporting during the transitional phase and progressively establish third-party verified carbon data systems. Non-compliance may significantly raise trade costs and even impede market access. Companies are advised to map EU-bound product lists, engage EU-accredited verifiers, and assess supply chain carbon footprint optimisation opportunities.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission DG CLIMA Policy Briefing · 2026.09.10

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭承认与执行中国法院商事判决，跨境债权实现路径进一步拓宽
case.summary: 近期新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）在一宗跨境买卖合同纠纷中，依据互惠原则承认并执行了中国内地法院作出的生效商事判决。该案明确，在满足正当程序、终局性及不违反公共政策等条件下，中国法院判决可在新加坡获得承认与执行。对于在东南亚有资产布局的中国企业而言，这意味着通过中国诉讼取得生效判决后，可直接向新加坡法院申请执行，无需另行提起实体诉讼，显著降低跨境债权实现的时间与成本。建议企业在跨境交易中注重选择有利的争议解决条款与资产所在地。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭案例观察 · 2026年第三季度
case.title_en: SICC Recognises and Enforces Chinese Commercial Judgment, Widening Cross-Border Debt Recovery Paths
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) recently recognised and enforced a final commercial judgment of a mainland Chinese court in a cross-border sale of goods dispute, based on the principle of reciprocity. The case confirms that Chinese court judgments may be recognised and enforced in Singapore where due process, finality, and public policy requirements are satisfied. For Chinese enterprises with assets in Southeast Asia, this means that after obtaining a final judgment through Chinese litigation, they can directly seek enforcement before Singapore courts without initiating substantive proceedings anew, substantially reducing time and costs in cross-border debt recovery. Companies should carefully consider dispute resolution clauses and asset locations in cross-border transactions.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施扩展，涉外企业数据合规迎来新指引
policy.summary: 粤港澳大湾区近期进一步扩展跨境数据流动便利化安排，在医疗、金融、贸易等重点领域试点数据跨境传输“白名单”机制，并简化安全评估与标准合同备案流程。对于在大湾区设有分支机构或数据中心的企业而言，该政策有助于降低跨境数据传输的合规成本，但仍须履行个人信息保护影响评估、数据分类分级等义务。建议企业结合自身业务场景，评估是否适用便利化通道，并同步完善内部数据合规制度，避免因数据出境违规而承担行政或民事责任。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室政策解读 · 2026年9月
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Expands Cross-Border Data Flow Facilitation, Offering New Compliance Guidance for Foreign-Related Enterprises
policy.summary_en: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area has further expanded facilitation arrangements for cross-border data flows, piloting a 'whitelist' mechanism for cross-border data transfers in key sectors such as healthcare, finance, and trade, while streamlining security assessment and standard contract filing procedures. For enterprises with branches or data centres in the GBA, this policy helps reduce compliance costs for cross-border data transfers, but obligations such as personal information protection impact assessments and data classification and grading remain. Companies should assess whether they qualify for facilitated channels based on their business scenarios, and simultaneously improve internal data compliance systems to avoid administrative or civil liability arising from unlawful data exports.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province Policy Interpretation · September 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：供应链尽职调查义务趋严，出海企业应建立动态合规机制
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：近期欧美在供应链人权、环境及强迫劳动领域的尽职调查立法与执法持续加码，中国出海企业面临从“被动应对”向“主动合规”转型的压力。建议企业：一是建立覆盖供应商准入、履约与退出的全流程尽职调查制度，将人权、环境及制裁合规指标嵌入采购合同；二是对高风险地区及行业开展专项审计，保留可追溯的合规证据；三是利用合同条款合理分配合规责任与赔偿风险；四是关注欧盟《企业可持续尽职调查指令》及各成员国转化立法的实施节奏，动态调整合规策略。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law 编辑部 · 2026.09.10
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Tightening Supply Chain Due Diligence Obligations Require Dynamic Compliance Mechanisms for Outbound Enterprises
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: With Europe and the United States intensifying legislation and enforcement on human rights, environmental, and forced labour due diligence in supply chains, Chinese outbound enterprises face pressure to shift from reactive response to proactive compliance. Recommended actions: first, establish a full-process due diligence system covering supplier onboarding, performance, and exit, embedding human rights, environmental, and sanctions compliance indicators into procurement contracts; second, conduct targeted audits in high-risk regions and sectors, retaining traceable compliance evidence; third, allocate compliance responsibilities and indemnity risks reasonably through contractual clauses; fourth, monitor the implementation pace of the EU Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive and member state transposition laws, and dynamically adjust compliance strategies.
